title: The relationship tarot spread
description: How the seven-card relationship tarot spread works for partners, family, friends or colleagues, with each position explained and tips for balanced reading.

scenes.headline: The relationship tarot spread
scenes.caption: The relationship tarot spread uses seven cards to look at two people and the connection between them. It suits any kind of relationship, not just romantic ones.
scenes.vo: The relationship tarot spread uses seven cards to look at two people and the connection between them. It suits any kind of relationship, not just romantic ones.

scenes.headline: The seven positions
scenes.caption: You, the other person, the connection between you, what brings you together, then what is challenging.
scenes.vo: The seven positions. You, the other person, the connection between you, what brings you together, then what is challenging.

scenes.headline: The layout
scenes.caption: Card 1 sits on the left and card 2 on the right, facing each other. Card 3 goes in the centre between them.
scenes.vo: The layout. Card 1 sits on the left and card 2 on the right, facing each other. Card 3 goes in the centre between them.
